inv.desc_ca:

En Exclusiva, Inmoolaya presenta un excepcional Traspàs Restaurant Barcelona amb llicència C3 Mixt de 230 m² en traspàs, situat al carrer Aribau per sobre de Diagonal. la via principal i més transitada de Sant Gervasi Galvany. Aquest local, distribuït en dues plantes, compta amb una cuina completa equipada amb ascensor muntaplats, lavabos, àrees d'emmagatzematge, despatx i vestidors a la planta baixa. A la planta principal, destaca una còmoda barra i una zona de menjador dividida en dues semi plantes.

Ubicat a la zona de moda de Barcelona, a Sant Gervasi Galvany, aquest restaurant es troba en una zona d'alta densitat residencial i empresarial, coneguda per la seva oferta d'oci i el seu elevat nivell adquisitiu. L'establiment, recentment reformat, té un aforament interior per a 90 persones i espai per a 16 persones a la seva agradable terrassa amb quatre taules i cadires.

Aquesta oportunitat és única per la seva privilegiada ubicació, la llicència que posseeix i el seu atractiu preu. El traspàs s'ofereix per 160.000€, i el lloguer és aproximadament de 3.000€

REF: 7045863

Exclusively, Inmoolaya presents an exceptional Restaurant Transfer in Barcelona with a C3 Mixed license of 230 m² for transfer, located on Aribau street above Diagonal. The main and busiest street of Sant Gervasi Galvany. This premises, distributed over two floors, has a fully equipped kitchen with a dumbwaiter, toilets, storage areas, office and changing rooms on the ground floor. On the main floor, there is a comfortable bar and a dining area divided into two semi-levels.

Located in the trendy area of Barcelona, in Sant Gervasi Galvany, this restaurant is located in an area of high residential and business density, known for its leisure offer and its high purchasing power. The establishment, recently renovated, has an interior capacity for 90 people and space for 16 people on its pleasant terrace with four tables and chairs.

This opportunity is unique due to its privileged location, the license it possesses and its attractive price. The transfer is offered for €160,000, and the rent is approximately €3,000.

Don't miss the opportunity to acquire this outstanding restaurant that combines a privileged location with modern and functional facilities! Contact us for more information and take the step towards your next gastronomic project!
